name: Nuestra Señora del Ocio
summary: A shipwreck off Key Lento that Push Square says the player finds automatically during the story mission Island Dreams.
body: Push Square places Nuestra Señora del Ocio in Key Lento, Mariana County, and says it is found automatically as part of the story mission Island Dreams.
Push Square says 10 doubloons have to be collected there to clear the wreck from the map.
Push Square says 33 Underwater Discoveries exist in all, that scuba gear is needed and that progress shows under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures / Exploration.

name: Nuestra Señora de la Noche
summary: A shipwreck south of Key Lento holding seven of Kenton's treasures.
body: Push Square places Nuestra Señora de la Noche south of Key Lento in Mariana County and lists seven treasures there: Antique Candlestick, Dragon Pipe, Ivory Saint, Pewter Gauntlet, Purple Gemstone, Serpentine Statue and Stained Doubloon.
GTA BOOM agrees on the seven finds and puts the wreck in the search circle southeast of the tip of Key Lento, the nearer of two circles, in the Leonida Straits.
GTA BOOM says one of the seven is a separate chest on the seabed that shows an Open prompt rather than Treasure, and that Kenton paid $200 for that chest in its run.
Push Square says 33 Underwater Discoveries exist in all, that scuba gear is needed and that progress shows under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures / Exploration.

name: Nuestra Señora de la Ética Laxa
summary: A shipwreck south of Key Lento and Abismo Key holding five of Kenton's treasures.
body: Push Square places Nuestra Señora de la Ética Laxa south of Key Lento and Abismo Key in Mariana County, with five treasures: Ancient Snuff Box, Battered Doubloon, Ceremonial Spoon, Golden Chalice and Golden Pendant.
GTA BOOM also gives five treasures and says it is the farther south of the two marked circles, off the coast near Abismo Key.
Push Square says 33 Underwater Discoveries exist in all, that scuba gear is needed and that progress shows under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures / Exploration.

name: Urca de Cinco Torres
summary: A shipwreck off south-eastern Key Lento holding six of Kenton's treasures.
body: Push Square places the Urca de Cinco Torres off the south-eastern coast of Key Lento in Mariana County, near a group of green islands.
Push Square lists six treasures there: Ancient Ceremonial Mask, Ceremonial Plate, Golden Glove, Jade-Eye Cup, Rusty Doubloon and Sacred Necklace.
Push Square says 33 Underwater Discoveries exist in all, that scuba gear is needed and that progress shows under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures / Exploration.

name: Nuestra Señora Lujuriosa

body: Push Square places Nuestra Señora Lujuriosa off the south-eastern coast of Key Lento in Mariana County, near the same group of green islands as the Urca de Cinco Torres.
Push Square lists six treasures there: Ceremonial Bowl, Ceremonial Knife, Golden Llama, Golden Statuette, Jade-Lobe Tankard and Shiny Doubloon.
Push Square says 33 Underwater Discoveries exist in all, that scuba gear is needed and that progress shows under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures / Exploration.

name: Downtown Periscope

body: Push Square places the Downtown Periscope close to Catalan Blvd, Downtown, Vice City, Vice-Dale County.
Scans count toward the 100 of 112 WAiNK locations needed for the You WAiNKer! trophy and 100% completion, as GameTrek lists them.

name: Sky Ride

body: Push Square places the Sky Ride east of the Emerald River in Emerald Springs, Kelly County, and says its height makes it visible through the trees.

body: Push Square places the Hoffman Observatory in the western part of North Kelly County, on a hill overlooking Vice City.

body: Push Square places this utility marking on the floor on Shore Dr in Ocean Beach, Vice Beach, across from The Buckingham.
Push Square says Cal first texts the player about these markings, that they are scanned with WAiNK, and that it did not yet know how many exist; GameTrek gives 23 No Flusher Tags.

Push Square says Twin's Laird 350 sniper rifle can be picked up at the same lookout, and that the 27 magazines, books and comics are tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration.

name: Humanatee and Seductive Mermaid tattoos

name: Meteorite chunks
summary: Glowing meteorite pieces scattered across Leonida that The Big Lead says are easiest to spot at night.
body: The Big Lead lists meteorite chunks as a collectible and advises searching at night because they glow in the dark.

It places five in the underwater tunnels of the Selkie Hole in Emerald Springs, one under a bed in a Belville garage, one on a desk in the Sands of Time home in Waning Sands, and one beside the Wreck of the Meerwunder.

Other spots it gives include the rocks below the tower south-east of Killtelligence Provisions, the Sandbars, the Zephyr, Saint Attaway, Hyde and Frampton islands, under the pier on Belpoint, under a lighthouse in Leonida Bay and two on an island west of Leonida Bay south of Bobcat Key.
The guide gives no total, and the app's Kenton entry records that DayOne lists meteorites sold among Kenton's stats.
